correctness.rationale: A cyclic orbit has at most one codeword; the ordered binary context construction attains the necklace bound. Equality conditions on every repeated and distinct triple imply tied pairs form a matching, oriented quotient blocks form a transitive tournament, and all matrices are ordered blocks of size at most two. Every off-diagonal and noninitial diagonal appears as a code prefix or suffix, so distinct codes are exactly quotient matrices by the invisible first singleton diagonal. This proves q!(P_(q+1)-P_q) for all q≥2. Separate exhaustive matrix and ordered-block verifiers agree through q=5.
